lead.zh-Hans: 我们各让了一边，结果还是走到了一起。
lead.en: We chose opposite sides and still met in the middle.

text.zh-Hans: 妮凯艺术画廊里，我和一位旅人同时往旁边让，结果又站到同一侧。他笑着指向另一头，我点头，以为这回能分开慢慢看。没走多久，我们却在同一处作品前碰面。他先收回准备指路的手，我也把脚摆正，让中间留出不必躲让的空处。刚才各向一边的两双鞋，这回终于并排站定，谁也没有先走。
text.en: In Nike Art Gallery, a traveler and I both stepped aside and landed on the same side again. He indicated the other end, and I nodded, expecting to browse separately. A little later, we met before the same work. He lowered his pointing hand while I straightened my feet, leaving enough space between us. The shoes that had kept choosing opposite directions were finally standing side by side. Neither pair moved away.

text.zh-Hans: 邀请他一起看眼前的作品
text.en: Invite him to look at this work together

text.zh-Hans: 看看我们各自往哪边让
text.en: Notice which way each of us steps

lead.zh-Hans: 它转头看了一眼，我把拉链停住了。
lead.en: One look was enough to pause the zip.

text.zh-Hans: 莱基保护中心的步道旁，树间一只猴子正动来动去。我想把水壶放回包里，拉链刚响，它便转头望过来。我立刻停手，没有靠近，也没有拿食物。旁边的旅人同样安静下来，等猴子沿树枝移远，我才把包口慢慢合好。他问我是不是忘了喝水，我举起已经空的水壶，两个人压低声音笑了一下。
text.en: A monkey moved among the trees beside the nature trail at Lekki Conservation Centre. As I put my bottle away, my zip sounded and the monkey turned. I stopped without approaching or taking out food. A traveler beside me grew quiet too. Once the monkey moved farther along the branches, I closed the bag slowly. Had I forgotten to drink, he asked? I showed him the empty bottle, and we shared a subdued laugh.

text.zh-Hans: 轻声告诉他水喝完了
text.en: Quietly explain that the bottle is empty

text.zh-Hans: 远远看猴子移到哪边
text.en: Watch the monkey from a distance

lead.zh-Hans: 点心是圆的，我的回答暂时也是。
lead.en: My answer had to wait behind a round mouthful.

text.zh-Hans: 乔洛夫饭吃完，旅伴拿起一颗甜味炸面团球，问我想不想再尝一个。我刚咬下一口，不能马上回答，便点头，他却误会成我已经够了。我先咽好再说想尝，他看着手里还没吃的那颗，笑着放回干净的小碟。我没有急着伸手，先喝口水，让两边鼓起的脸颊慢慢恢复，才郑重接过第二颗圆圆的点心。
text.en: After jollof rice, my companion lifted a sweet puff-puff and asked whether I wanted another. With a bite already in my mouth, I nodded. He took that to mean I had enough. Once I had swallowed, I clarified. Laughing, he put the untouched piece on a clean side plate. I drank some water and let my cheeks return to their ordinary shape before accepting the second round treat.

text.zh-Hans: 吃好再把回答说清楚
text.en: Finish the mouthful before answering clearly

text.zh-Hans: 看看两边脸颊鼓不鼓
text.en: Check whether my cheeks are still full

lead.zh-Hans: 他的故事停在半句，我的午饭也停在半勺。
lead.en: His story paused halfway, and so did my spoon.

text.zh-Hans: 我尝着番茄香的乔洛夫饭，旅伴讲起自己一路上把帽子戴反的事。他讲到最可笑的一段忽然停下来，低头又检查了一遍自己的帽子。我举着半勺饭等他，看见帽檐这回朝前，便用空着的手指了指。他摸摸帽子，放心接着讲。我把那勺吃好，饭后又尝了炸面团球，讲故事的人总算能两只手都拿来比划。
text.en: Over tomato-flavored jollof rice, my companion told me about traveling with his hat on backwards. At the funniest point, he stopped to check it again. I waited with half a spoonful, then used my free hand to indicate that the brim was correctly forward. Reassured, he continued. I finished the spoonful and later tried puff-puff while he finally gave both hands to illustrating his tale.

text.zh-Hans: 请他放心继续讲帽子
text.en: Encourage him to finish the hat story

text.zh-Hans: 看看帽檐这回朝哪里
text.en: Check which way the brim points

lead.zh-Hans: 树上掉下来一滴，我的帽子多留了一会儿。
lead.en: One drop stayed with my hat longer than expected.

text.zh-Hans: 沿着莱基保护中心的栈道走，一滴水从树叶落到帽檐上。我听见轻轻的一声，抬头没找见下一滴，便继续往前。等停到不挡人的地方擦额头，我把帽子往前一倾，那滴水才顺着边缘滑下来，落到自己的鞋面。我没有再抬头找树叶，只把帽檐晾开一点，慢慢等鞋上那个深色的小点变浅再往前走。
text.en: A drop fell from a leaf onto my hat brim as I followed Lekki’s boardwalk. Hearing the little tap, I looked up for another, then walked on. Later, in a clear place, I tipped the hat to wipe my forehead. The waiting drop slid onto my shoe. This time I left the leaves out of the investigation, opened the brim a little and watched the dark spot on my shoe begin to fade.

text.zh-Hans: 说说晚到的那滴水
text.en: Describe the drop’s delayed arrival

text.zh-Hans: 留意鞋面水点的颜色
text.en: Watch the spot on my shoe lighten

lead.zh-Hans: 我先转好空椅子，端饭的人就有了落脚处。
lead.en: Turning the empty chair gave lunch somewhere to settle.

text.zh-Hans: 我正吃乔洛夫饭，邻桌的旅人端着盘子找地方坐，身后的椅子却朝着另一边。我问过他，帮忙把空椅转好，再退开让他坐稳。他的同伴随后带来甜味炸面团球，也分给我尝了一颗。我把自己的盘子挪出一点空处接好，三个人这才都不用再站着。他笑着试了试椅背，我也靠回去，两边的肩膀一同落了下来。
text.en: While I ate jollof rice, a traveler at the next table tried to settle with his plate, but the empty chair faced the wrong way. With his permission, I turned it and stepped back. His companion arrived with sweet puff-puff and offered me one. I made room beside my plate to receive it. Now all three of us could sit. He tested his chair back, I leaned into mine, and our shoulders lowered together.

text.zh-Hans: 谢谢同伴分来的点心
text.en: Thank the companion for sharing the treat

text.zh-Hans: 看看椅子转好了没有
text.en: Check the chair’s direction

lead.zh-Hans: 你说“{reply}”，我们这回不再分头走。
lead.en: You wrote, “{reply}.” This time we stayed together.

text.zh-Hans: 我邀请那位总与我走到同一侧的旅人，一起看眼前的作品。他站好后，我也留出一小段空处，不再忙着给他指另一头。我们各自看了一会儿，他忽然小声问我是不是还打算让路。我摇头，两个人便笑起来。随后他先往旁边移一步，我等他停稳才跟上，肩膀之间始终留着舒服的距离，没有谁再把谁让回原处。
text.en: I invited the traveler who kept choosing the same side to look at the work together. We settled with comfortable space between us, without pointing toward opposite ends. After a while he quietly asked whether I was planning another evasive maneuver. I shook my head, and we laughed. When he moved to the next spot, I waited before following. The distance between our shoulders stayed easy, and neither of us sent the other back to the start.

text.zh-Hans: 告诉他不用再让到另一头
text.en: Tell him there is no need to retreat again

text.zh-Hans: 看看肩膀之间的空处
text.en: Notice the space between our shoulders

lead.zh-Hans: 这条路还认得，耳边的声响先走了一步。
lead.en: The trail was familiar, but the sound arrived first.

text.zh-Hans: 拉各斯的莱基保护中心又迎来我这双小脚，林间步道仍然认得。前面的旅人忽然停下，侧着头听，我也跟着把脚放轻。他以为我看见了什么，转过来问，我说自己只是在跟着他听。两个人一同静下来，才发现那阵沙沙声来自他衣袖擦过包带。他把胳膊挪开，声音停了，林子深处细细的动静这才慢慢浮上来。
text.en: My feet found Lekki Conservation Centre again in Lagos, recognizing the trail through the trees. A traveler ahead stopped and tilted his head, so I softened my steps too. Had I spotted something, he asked? I was only listening because he was. In the shared pause, we traced a rustle to his sleeve brushing his strap. He moved his arm. With that sound gone, quieter movements deeper among the trees gradually became audible.

text.zh-Hans: 承认自己跟着他听
text.en: Admit that I was following his listening

text.zh-Hans: 分辨衣袖停下后的声音
text.en: Listen after the sleeve stops rustling
